title: Hover surface lite: deferred tooltips and ARIA region strategy
creator: Marina Alvarez
description: Goal: reduce tooltip/legend rendering costs for high-density time-series charts while preserving keyboard + screen reader usability. Produce a lightweight hover surface pattern that defers expensive DOM work (rich HTML tooltips, charts overlays) until user intent is confirmed, and define an ARIA region strategy that avoids audible spam for screen readers when many points update. Scope includes canvas + DOM hybrid charts, legend strip, and mobile touch fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Hover surface component exists that exposes a low-cost DOM hit area (rect) for points and series; default state renders only necessary semantic labels (no heavy HTML).

Deferred tooltip flow: first interaction shows an inline plain-text sr-only announcement + lightweight outline; after 150ms of hover or on explicit click, the rich tooltip is mounted. Timing is configurable per-chart.

ARIA strategy documented: use a single polite aria-live region for focus/hover announcements; no per-point aria-live; keyboard focus reads series label + value once, and repeated updates are throttled.
Performance: initial render CPU cost for dense charts reduced by >=30% in synthetic benchmark (50k point viewport) compared to current tooltip implementation.
design_decisions: Use a transparent SVG/DOM hit surface overlay with pointer-events for mouse + keyboard interaction; canvas retains rendering responsibility for datapoints to minimize DOM nodes.
Introduce a two-stage tooltip lifecycle: 'preview' (text-only, cheap) + 'full' (rich, interactive). Preview appears immediately; full mounts after debounce or explicit user action.
ARIA: single polite aria-live region for announcements to avoid screen reader flooding; expose 'announce' API on chart component for assistive tech teams to customize messages.
Mobile: touch uses long-press to promote preview -> full to avoid accidental mounts on scroll/fling.
Accessibility trade-off: preview primarily provides sufficient info for most a11y flows; power users can enable persistent full tooltips via chart prop.
engineering_notes: Runtime: implement hit-surface as lightweight SVG rects (~N rects where N = visible series) instead of per-point DOM nodes; pointer mapping uses nearest-neighbor in canvas coords to compute preview text.
Metrics to capture: tooltip mount rate, full-tooltip render time, CPU usage during mousemove floods, and # of aria-live announcements emitted per session.
Telemetry experiment: enable for 10% of charts on staging to measure perf delta and a11y events before full rollout.
review_comments: PM (Ravi): Ensure preview contains series name + timestamp + numeric value; users rely on timestamp for debugging spikes.
Eng (Sofia): 150ms debounce seems optimistic on mobile; suggest 200-250ms on touch to avoid accidental promotions.
A11y (Jordan): Single aria-live is good, but need guidance for internationalized reading order and number formatting; add locale-aware announce template.
Design (Aisha): Add visual affordance for keyboard focus (high-contrast halo) and a documented keyboard flow (Tab -> arrow navigation -> Enter to pin full tooltip).
